name: OpenFOAM.com v2312 Slurm templates
description: Draft-only job templates for the verified OpenFOAM.com v2312 target.

templates.name: OpenFOAM.com v2312 on TRUBA
templates.description: Loads OpenFOAM v2312 and runs the case-local Allrun generated by Studio, using the Slurm task count for parallel execution.

variables.name: nodes
variables.description: Slurm node count; keep it consistent with total tasks and the active account limits.

variables.name: ntasks
variables.description: Slurm MPI task count; Allrun decomposes the case when needed and uses this allocation.

variables.name: time_limit
variables.description: Suggested wall time; confirm the active account and partition limits before submission.
